scope: Assessment structure, pinned source-link syntax, and referenced local file containment/existence/line bounds.

campaigns.scope: Recorded settings, completeness, parity admission metadata, aggregate arithmetic and ranking separation; no engine execution or array-parity recomputation.

limitations: This read-only gate does not verify local git/build byte identity, interpret whether source lines support a claim, exclude comments within code, replay numerical/statistical results, or enforce CPU/thread-pool isolation.
